place_story.kicker: The map is part of the lesson
place_story.title: A narrow foothill vineyard, not one uniform site
place_story.text: Read Jura north to south along the western edge of the mountains. The active outlines separate geographic origins from categories that can share the same ground.

place.intro: Western escarpment · a narrow strip · shared ground
place.lede: One compact strip of eastern France, read north to south, carrying more than one wine geography at a time.

grapes.lede: Five principal grapes share a compact region. The two largest shares lead to radically different lessons; the smaller three complete the picture without being reduced to tasting stereotypes.

people.intro: Four producers · four ways into the world
people.lede: These producers are not a ranking. Facts do not animate a region: these four make place, grapes, farming, cellar work and lineage concrete.

culture.lede: Jura's cultural pull is easiest to understand through transmission and access, not hype. Two bounded ideas earn their place here.

rules.lede: Rules distinguish origins, categories and methods that can share ground.

rules.intro: Jura's six AOPs do not form a simple ladder. The map makes the distinction visible: four name geographic origins; two overlap the region while governing sparkling wine or {{term:mistelle|mistelle}}.

groups.label: Geographic AOPs
groups.note: Four origins. Select one to isolate its outline and open its native guide.

groups.label: Overlapping wine categories
groups.note: These can occupy the same ground while governing different methods and wine types.
